turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
Because updating a shipping address can change the taxes on your order, our team needs to process it directly so any payment adjustments are handled correctly and securely.

Please call our customer care team as soon as you can so they can update the address for you:

• Phone: (800) 820-0465
• Hours: Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST

If you call promptly after placing the order, they’ll do everything they can to get the address updated before it ships.
